# Native translation references

The web application's native translation catalog comes from the verified
`windows-r0-20261012-02` desktop source capture. It preserves the original English
lookup keys and all eight native language columns without adding browser wording.

| Captured source | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [translations.inc](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/src/translations.inc) | 592 English keys and the eight translation columns |
| [language.cpp](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/src/language.cpp) | Language order, native labels, exact-key lookup and locale behavior |
| [language.hpp](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/src/language.hpp) | Native language and translation contracts |
| [language_contracts.cpp](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/tests/language_contracts.cpp) | UTF-8, nonempty values, unique keys and ordered printf specifier checks |
| [CAPTURE_MANIFEST.json](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/CAPTURE_MANIFEST.json) | Captured byte sizes, SHA-256 values and capture identity |
| [LICENSE](../../reference/targets/windows-r0-20261012-02/source/LICENSE) | Original OpsiClear proprietary ownership notice |

The capture ID is `cc71f0df-8f38-4900-8aff-5c9ee0d6814c`. The translation table is
195,483 bytes with SHA-256
`cc87e6c8e130805f1edca9e96eb4c83c943116dd151234eda60912ddcb15940a`.

The table contains proprietary SplatView material:

> Copyright (c) 2026 OpsiClear LLC. All rights reserved.

Generation preserves that ownership and grants no MIT license or additional
redistribution permission. The original captured notice is copied byte for byte
to [public/licenses/SplatView-translations.txt](../../public/licenses/SplatView-translations.txt),
served at `/licenses/SplatView-translations.txt`. Its SHA-256 is
`ff39f450fd56ce98a7da38c5981e2f4661c55cdd404b6294eace5e805f9fc132`.
The generated catalog and provenance both record its ownership, source path and
license hash.

Run the standard-library generator from the repository root:

```text
python -B tools/generate-native-translations.py
python -B tools/generate-native-translations.py --check
python -B -m unittest discover -s tests/tools -p test_native_translations.py
```

The generator emits deterministic UTF-8 data at
[src/generated/native-translations.json](../../src/generated/native-translations.json)
and verification details at
[src/generated/native-translations.provenance.json](../../src/generated/native-translations.provenance.json).
It verifies the pinned capture manifest and all referenced source hashes before
writing. `--check` compares the exact generated bytes without writing files.

The catalog exposes `languageOptions` in native order: `system`, `en`, `es`, `fr`,
`de`, `pt`, `zh-Hans`, `ja`, `ko`. `system` is a language preference; the `catalogs`
object contains the remaining eight locale dictionaries. Each dictionary has 592
case-sensitive English source keys, with an identity dictionary for English.
Values preserve all original Unicode text, printf specifiers and escaped line
breaks. The verified census is 4,736 translation values, 11 format-bearing keys
and 24 multiline keys with 39 line-feed characters in each locale.

The parser accepts only a bounded, nonrecursive subset of the captured C++ string
initializer syntax. It rejects expressions, macros, raw strings, string prefixes,
adjacent string concatenation, unsupported escapes and trailing code. UTF-8,
native BMP character limits, nonempty values, key uniqueness, exact printf
specifier order and newline-run order are checked. It performs no normalization,
case folding or wording changes. Any new capture or unsupported source syntax
requires review of the pins and parser before regeneration.
